networks.name: kongsi_bill_splitter
networks.description: Tell me who had what, and I will put it on the bill. The page works out every share to the sen.
sample_queries: Ali had nasi lemak RM 12.90, Mei had char kuey teow RM 11.50 and we all shared satay RM 18. 10% service charge, 6% SST. Ali paid.
How much does each person on the bill pay?
Three of us shared a RM 96.40 dinner with 10% service and 6% tax. What does each pay, rounded to 5 sen?
Clear the bill so we can start a new one.
Can you send Mei's share to Ali by DuitNow?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only. Other agent sites may call this network; its bridge shares calculate_split.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
